text: TTF opens firmer on reports of unplanned maintenance at a Norwegian processing plant; flows to the continent down sharply on the day.
VLCC MEG–China fixtures thin; owners hold offers above last done as charterers wait for the weekend's transit picture.
FLASH — Unidentified small craft reported near the inbound Hormuz lane; two tankers alter course, no contact. Transit count unaffected so far.
Air-power desk: long read on the F-105 and the origins of SEAD is live; dossier updated with variant table.
EU gas storage fill edges higher; injections slow as the front of the curve flattens into October.
Demo A&D index closes near its highs as a European prime reports order backlog above two years of revenue.
Container lines flag further Cape routings for Q4 schedules; Bab el-Mandeb transit count remains well below the pre-crisis baseline.
Gulf littoral states issue a joint statement on freedom of navigation ahead of next week's naval exercise.
JKM–TTF spread narrows; two Atlantic cargoes reported diverted back toward Europe.
Capesize 5TC softens on lighter iron-ore enquiry out of West Australia; Atlantic holds.
Shipyard capacity: three more PCTC slots reported taken for 2029 delivery; dual-fuel LNG specified.
Aviation heritage: restored F-105G to be displayed at a Guard base open day; the last flying Thud retired in 1984.
EUA December contract steady; auction volumes for Q4 published.
War-risk underwriters widen the listed area in the southern Red Sea; premium indications firmer for the week.
Brief: VLCC rates firm on positioning risk rather than demand — the premium is in the ballast leg.
Henry Hub drifts lower on mild weather; LNG feedgas steady near record.
Dossier: Strait of Hormuz reference updated with bypass capacity and the incident timeline.
SCFI composite lower for a third week as newbuild deliveries land on the long-route loops.
Procurement: parliamentary committee schedules hearing on strategic sealift charter renewal.
Dossier: Republic F-105 Thunderchief reference is live with spec sheet and variants.
